clips.title: The story
paras: Tundra MacGrann has a month's worth of salted meat set aside for winter in Dun Morogh. His provisions are locked in a thorium meat locker, but Old Icebeard has carried off the whole cache.

Tundra MacGrann prepared for winter by hunting game and salting the meat. He stored weeks of provisions in a sturdy chest, then locked it in a thorium meat locker to keep scavenging bears and prowling predators away from his homestead. Even so, he never expected an intruder strong enough to carry off the whole chest instead of trying to pry it open.

Old Icebeard raided MacGrann's camp while the dwarf was away tracking deer and dragged the heavy chest to his den in Chill Breeze Valley. The yeti cannot break through the solid thorium plating, but MacGrann's injured leg keeps him from mounting a swift rescue into the cavern. Without help retrieving the cache before winter sets in, the stranded hunter faces starvation in the mountain snows.
